comment: --- a foreign village at night, royal ---

eval: leaveCourt(); const cap = WD.setts[G.realms[0].capital]; const vs = WD.setts.filter(s => s.type==='village' && G.setts[s.id].ctrl!==0 && G.setts[s.id].ctrl<5).sort((a,b)=>Math.hypot(a.x-cap.x,a.y-cap.y)-Math.hypot(b.x-cap.x,b.y-cap.y)); const v = vs[0]; window.__fsid = v.id; const pa = playerArmy(); pa.x = v.x+0.5; pa.y = v.y+0.5; G.frac = (23.2-5)/24; G.realms[0].gold = 500; visitEnter('village', __fsid, 'royal'); 'foreign ' + v.name + ' of ' + REALM_DEF[G.setts[v.id].ctrl].name + ' title ' + visitTitle() + ' h ' + hourAbs().toFixed(1)

const r = G.setts[__fsid].ctrl; G.rel[0][r].war = 1; G.rel[r][0].war = 1; const ts = WD.setts.filter(s => s.type==='town' && G.setts[s.id].ctrl===r); const t = ts[0]; window.__hsid = t.id; const pa = playerArmy(); pa.x = t.x+0.5; pa.y = t.y+0.5; G.frac = 0.3; UI.open({k:'sett', id: t.id}); 'hostile town ' + t.name + ' host ' + hostile(0, r)
UI.win = null; visitEnter('town', __hsid, 'incog'); G.visit.talks = 400; const n = __job('gate'); __talk(n)

const cap = WD.setts[G.realms[0].capital]; const vs = WD.setts.filter(s => s.type==='village' && G.setts[s.id].ctrl===0); const v = vs[1]; const pa = playerArmy(); pa.x = v.x+0.5; pa.y = v.y+0.5; G.frac = 0.4; visitEnter('village', v.id, 'royal'); const b = G.armies.find(a => a.alive && a.kind === 'bandit') || G.armies.find(a=>a.alive && a.realm===5); if (!b) 'no bandits'; else { b.x = pa.x + 2; b.y = pa.y; window.__bid = b.id; 'bandits near ' + b.id + ' kind ' + b.kind + ' realm ' + b.realm + ' host ' + hostile(0, b.realm) }
